title: [trixie][build] ycabled wheel-test fails with ImportError: runtime_version (protobuf 3.21.12 APT shadows pip 5.29.6 in slave)
author: yxieca
body:
> Filed by **sonic-build** agent (automated build/CI assistant for SONiC sonic-buildimage workstreams). Discovered while validating an unrelated sflow fix on the trixie slave.

## Description

The `sonic_ycabled-1.0-py3-none-any.whl` wheel build on the `trixie` slave deterministically fails at the pytest collection step with:

```
ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version' from 'google.protobuf' 
(/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/google/protobuf/__init__.py)
```

The failure happens on master (verified on current `HEAD` around commits `32d8a8ac5` / `cdd95e6aa`) and blocks any full-image `make target/sonic-vs.img.gz` build that includes the trixie ycabled wheel target with tests enabled.

## Reproduction

```bash
# On a sonic-slave-trixie checkout with current master:
make PLATFORM=vs target/python-wheels/trixie/sonic_ycabled-1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

Full traceback (excerpted from `target/python-wheels/trixie/sonic_ycabled-1.0-py3-none-any.whl.log`):

```
============================= test session starts ==============================
platform linux -- Python 3.13.5, pytest-8.3.5, pluggy-1.5.0 -- /usr/bin/python3
rootdir: /sonic/src/sonic-platform-daemons/sonic-ycabled
configfile: pytest.ini
plugins: xdist-3.8.0, pyfakefs-6.2.0, typeguard-4.4.2, cov-5.0.0
collecting ... collected 0 items / 2 errors

==================================== ERRORS ====================================
________________ ERROR collecting tests/test_y_cable_helper.py _________________
ImportError while importing test module '/sonic/src/sonic-platform-daemons/sonic-ycabled/tests/test_y_cable_helper.py'.
Hint: make sure your test modules/packages have valid Python names.
Traceback:
/usr/lib/python3.13/importlib/__init__.py:88: in import_module
    return _bootstrap._gcd_import(name[level:], package, level)
tests/test_y_cable_helper.py:5: in <module>
    from ycable.ycable_utilities.y_cable_helper import *
ycable/ycable_utilities/y_cable_helper.py:21: in <module>
    from proto_out import linkmgr_grpc_driver_pb2_grpc
proto_out/linkmgr_grpc_driver_pb2_grpc.py:6: in <module>
    from proto_out import linkmgr_grpc_driver_pb2 as proto__out_dot_linkmgr__grpc__driver__pb2
proto_out/linkmgr_grpc_driver_pb2.py:9: in <module>
    from google.protobuf import runtime_version as _runtime_version
E   ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version' from 'google.protobuf' (/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/google/protobuf/__init__.py)
____________________ ERROR collecting tests/test_ycable.py _____________________
ImportError while importing test module '/sonic/src/sonic-platform-daemons/sonic-ycabled/tests/test_ycable.py'.
... (same root cause)
=========================== short test summary info ============================
ERROR tests/test_y_cable_helper.py
ERROR tests/test_ycable.py
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Interrupted: 2 errors during collection !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
======================== 6 warnings, 2 errors in 16.02s ========================
```

## Root cause

The `sonic-slave-trixie` image installs **two different `google.protobuf` runtimes** in different paths:

| Path | Source | Version |
|------|--------|---------|
| `/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/google/protobuf/` | pip (`grpcio==1.71.0 grpcio-tools==1.71.0`) — `sonic-slave-trixie/Dockerfile.j2` line 594 | **5.29.6** |
| `/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/google/protobuf/` | APT (`python3-protobuf`) — `sonic-slave-trixie/Dockerfile.j2` line 524 | **3.21.12-11** (Debian Trixie) |

The protobuf stub `src/sonic-platform-daemons/sonic-ycabled/proto_out/linkmgr_grpc_driver_pb2.py` is generated at build time by `grpcio-tools==1.71.0`. Its header reads:

```python
# Generated by the protocol buffer compiler.  DO NOT EDIT!
# NO CHECKED-IN PROTOBUF GENCODE
# source: proto_out/linkmgr_grpc_driver.proto
# Protobuf Python Version: 5.29.0
"""Generated protocol buffer code."""
from google.protobuf import descriptor as _descriptor
from google.protobuf import descriptor_pool as _descriptor_pool
from google.protobuf import runtime_version as _runtime_version    # <-- protobuf 5.27+ symbol
...
_runtime_version.ValidateProtobufRuntimeVersion(
    _runtime_version.Domain.PUBLIC,
    5, 29, 0,
    ...
)
```

So the generated code requires `protobuf >= 5.27` (where `runtime_version` was introduced).

In a clean default `python3` invocation, the pip-installed 5.29.6 in `/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/` correctly wins (it appears earlier in `sys.path`). But during wheel-test invocation:

1. Build runs as user `yxieca` (UID 1000), not root.
2. `setup_requires=['wheel', 'grpcio-tools']` in `src/sonic-platform-daemons/sonic-ycabled/setup.py` triggers `setuptools` `dist.fetch_build_eggs(dist.setup_requires)` (deprecated path).
3. Subsequent `python3 -m pytest` (invoked from `slave.mk` ~line 1103) ends up with a `sys.path` where `/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages` (containing the APT-installed protobuf **3.21.12**) shadows `/usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/` (pip protobuf 5.29.6).
4. Import of the generated `_pb2.py` fails because `runtime_version` doesn't exist in 3.21.12.

## Verification on the slave image

```bash
$ docker run --rm sonic-slave-trixie-yxieca:<tag> python3 -c "import google.protobuf as g; print(g.__version__, g.__file__)"
5.29.6 /usr/local/lib/python3.13/dist-packages/google/protobuf/__init__.py     # pip wins by default

$ docker run --rm sonic-slave-trixie-yxieca:<tag> python3 -c \
    "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages'); from google.protobuf import runtime_version"
ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version' from 'google.protobuf' (/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/google/protobuf/__init__.py)
# Confirms APT version (3.21.12) lacks runtime_version
```

## Impact

- Blocks any full-image VS build (`make target/sonic-vs.img.gz`) on the trixie slave whenever the ycabled wheel target with tests enabled is exercised.
- Deterministic, not a race — same wheel, same error, every time.
- Currently affects in-flight PRs that rebase onto master HEAD and require a full trixie image build for validation.

## Suggested fixes (any of these)

**Option A — slave image (preferred, fixes root cause):**
Drop `python3-protobuf` from APT install in `sonic-slave-trixie/Dockerfile.j2` (line 524 — `python3-protobuf \`). The trixie slave already pip-installs the right protobuf (5.29.6) via `grpcio==1.71.0`, so the APT one is redundant and harmful.

```diff
- python3-protobuf \
```

**Option B — generated stub (compatible with both protobuf 3.x and 5.x):**
Pin `setup_requires` in `src/sonic-platform-daemons/sonic-ycabled/setup.py` to `grpcio-tools<1.69` (pre-`runtime_version` era) so stubs target protobuf 4.x ABI:

```diff
  setup_requires=[
      'wheel',
-     'grpcio-tools'
+     'grpcio-tools<1.69'
  ],
```

Same change may be needed in other daemons that ship `.proto` files (search upstream `sonic-platform-daemons`, `sonic-utilities`, `sonic-host-services`, etc. for `grpcio-tools` in `setup_requires`).

**Option C — slave Dockerfile pin (least invasive):**
Force `python3-protobuf` install from Debian Backports or a SONiC-managed source where version is ≥5.27. Riskier — Debian Trixie shipped 3.21.12 as the only `python3-protobuf` apt candidate; a backport would need maintenance.

## Related upstream PRs

- #27698 (merged 2026-06-05) — Fix grpc version installed in the pmon container. Bumps pmon `grpcio` from 1.67.1 → 1.71.0 to match the slave. Related but different scope (runtime container vs build slave).
- #27722 (open) — Fix system manager protocol buffer race under parallel make. Unrelated to this issue.

## Environment

- Tested on: P520-2 with `sonic-slave-trixie-yxieca:66569804791` (rebuilt 2026-06-04 22:12 PDT) and `:8040c3f72bc` (3 weeks older — same versions, same failure).
- Master HEAD at time of report: `32d8a8ac5` (Fix grpc version installed in the pmon container).
- Python in slave: 3.13.5; pip: 25.x; grpcio-tools: 1.71.0; protobuf (pip): 5.29.6; python3-protobuf (apt): 3.21.12-11.

linkedPullRequests.title: Tell p4lang to use protobuf and grpcio installed via pip
linkedPullRequests.author: saiarcot895
linkedPullRequests.body:

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it

When building the KVM image, there is a chance that the ycabled tests fail because some protobuf import cannot be resolved. This is happening as a side effect of p4lang using the protobuf package installed from Debian (which is a different version than the one installed from pip) and also installing an `__init__.py` file into the system-wide `google` module namespace (as opposed to the one in `/usr/local/lib/python3/`), because it's installing some additional modules under that namespace.

Fixes #27737

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

To fix this, don't install python3-protobuf and python3-grpcio from Debian, so that only the version that we install via pip is available in the build environment. Additionally, modify the dependencies for the p4lang packages to not depend on these two packages.

comments.author: rookie-who
comments.body:
**Backport to 202605 is critical** — here's why:

The 202605 branch has **never had a successful pipeline 142 build**. All 3 attempts (builds 1133312, 1134118, 1134967) have failed due to this ycabled protobuf conflict (`ImportError: cannot import name 'runtime_version' from 'google.protobuf'`).

Without a successful build, no artifacts are published, which means **every sonic-utilities PR targeting 202605** fails at the "Download artifacts" step with `No builds currently exist in the pipeline definition supplied`.

Currently blocking:
- [sonic-utilities#4596](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4596) — SED test fix cherry-pick, can't run CI
- [sonic-buildimage#27773](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/27773) — sonic-utilities submodule update, blocked until the above merges

Dependency chain:
1. ycabled protobuf conflict → pipeline 142 fails on 202605 → no artifacts published
2. No artifacts → sonic-utilities CI can't download debs → [sonic-utilities#4596](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4596) can't run
3. [sonic-utilities#4596](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4596) can't merge → SED test fix not on 202605 → [sonic-buildimage#27773](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/27773) fails

This fix is the root blocker for the entire 202605 branch.
